title: [Cyrasei Lira'ka Meadery]
description: A long slab of dark, polished mahogany, positioned upon old whiskey barrels, serves as a counter running the length of the far wall, its surface etched with years of use.  Oak stools padded with honey-toned leather are arranged in a neat row along the counter, while smaller tables with cushioned chairs sit in quieter corners.  Lit candles flicker in glass sconces along the walls, their soft glow reflecting off rows of bottles perfectly arranged on open shelving behind the bar.
